data.description: Once per day as a standard action that doesn't provoke attacks of opportunity, a horned lizard can squirt a 5-foot-long stream of blood from the corners of its eyes. The animal's blood contains noxious chemicals, and a creature hit by the blood must succeed at a DC %1 Fortitude save or be sickened for 1d4 rounds.
data.name: Blood Squirt
